run_doxygen_html_generator: run the doxygen XML to HTML documentation generator with a given Doxyfile or conf.py config
parse_doxyfile_config: parse a Doxyfile configuration and extract settings like OUTPUT_DIRECTORY, XML_OUTPUT, and theme options
parse_xml_compound: parse a Doxygen XML compound file into structured data with classes, functions, enums, and variables
build_search_data_trie: build a serialized search data trie from parsed documentation symbols for client-side search
extract_metadata_prepass: extract metadata from Doxygen XML files including brief descriptions, templates, and compound URLs
